summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier). Added test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with parametrized valid and invalid cases, plus tests for a blank node without a path predicate and a non-node input. Ran pytest on the new test module and test/test_path.py with the shared venv Python: 41 passed. Ruff and Black are not installed in that venv, so formatting was checked by hand for line length only; one Turtle data line inside a string is 91 characters. Nothing was committed, and no existing files were modified. Choices beyond the spec: non-Node inputs raise TypeError; malformed or cyclic RDF lists raise SHACLPathError. Caveat: core SequencePath and AlternativePath flatten nested same-typed arguments, so nested sequences come back flat.
